title: NYC Pub Crawl Tour
includes: VIP expedited entry to all bars and clubs!
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Some bars/clubs may have loud music or flashing lights, so not appropriate for travelers with music or light sensitivity.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Looking for the ultimate way to explore New York City after dark? Our East Village & Lower East Side Pub Crawl dives deep into two of the city’s most iconic bar scenes—where punk rock was born, speakeasies still whisper, and the drinks never stop flowing.

Whether you're new to the city or just tired of the same old scene, this crawl introduces you to the raw, vibrant spirit of downtown Manhattan after dark.

Perfect for solo travelers, couples, and groups, this is a night built around connection—expect to meet fellow explorers, make amazing memories, and leave with new friends (and probably a few wild photos).

What You’ll Get:

Access to 4–5 handpicked bars and venues—ranging from iconic East Village dives to stylish LES lounges!

Exclusive drink specials and FREE SHOTS at every stop!

Skip-the-line VIP entry at an exclusive nightclub to close out the night!

A mix of travelers & locals ready to party!

Energetic hosts who bring the energy, keep the vibe going and the drinks flowing!
